resources.name: Crystallographic structure data for rutile, anatase, brookite TiO2; alpha- and beta-Ga2O3; cubic and monoclinic ZrO2; Li3NbO4; MnTiO3 ilmenite; ordered LiAl5O8; trirutile ZnSb2O6 and MgSb2O6

access.notes: Available from crystallographic databases such as ICSD or COD, or from the original structure papers cited in the manuscript (Vegard 1916 for anatase, Pauling & Sturdivant 1928 for brookite, Geller 1960 for beta-Ga2O3, etc.).

resources.name: Character tables for point groups D4h, D2h, D3d, C2h, T, Oh, O, S6, and related groups

access.notes: Standard group theory references (e.g., Wilson, Decius & Cross 1955; Koster et al. 1963) or online resources like the Bilbao Crystallographic Server.
